content: Mobile WebSocket clients should assume disconnects will happen (network transitions, backgrounding) and design for fast invisible reconnection rather than trying to keep the connection alive: use sequence numbers / last-seen message IDs so the server can replay missed events, cap reconnect retries (10-15 attempts / 2-5 min) before surfacing a disconnected state, queue unacknowledged outbound messages for resend, and use app-level heartbeats (e.g. 3 missed heartbeats) to detect dead connections reliably since TCP/WebSocket-level detection is unreliable on mobile.
